origin.description: Generalized entropy of a numeric vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values.

arguments.name: parameter
arguments.text: Order of the generalized entropy. NULL uses 0.5. Values 0 and 1 select the two Theil measures.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values first. If false, any missing value makes the result missing.

origin.details: Parameter 0 is Theil's second measure and parameter 1 is Theil's entropy measure. Any other parameter is mean((x / mean(x))^k - 1) / (k * (k - 1)).
origin.value: A single number, the generalized entropy.

translation.description: Generalized entropy of a numeric vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values. Missing values are NaN.

arguments.name: parameter
arguments.text: Order of the generalized entropy. None uses 0.5. Values 0 and 1 select the two Theil measures.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values first. If false, any missing value makes the result NaN.

translation.details: Parameter 0 calls Theil with parameter 1, and parameter 1 calls Theil with parameter 0. Any other parameter is mean((x / mean(x))^k - 1) / (k * (k - 1)).
translation.value: A single number, the generalized entropy.
translation.example:
from ineq.measures import entropy

# generate vector (of incomes)
x = [541, 1463, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11904, 22261]
print(entropy(x))
